name: AMP Video Embed Field
description: Provides an AMP-compatible field formatter for the Video Embed Field module, rendering YouTube/Vimeo videos as <amp-youtube>/<amp-vimeo> markup on AMP pages.
project_description:
This module add AMP Compatible Field Formatter for Video Embed Field.

 Back to top 

 Supported providers and components: 
 
 Youtube (included in Video Embed Field ) 
 Vimeo (included in Video Embed Field ) 
 
 Back to top 

 Providers and components not tested yet: 
 
 amp-dailymotion -> Dailymotion 
 
 Back to top 

 Not supported providers and components yet: 
 
 amp-brightcove -> Brightcove 
 amp-hulu -> Hulu 
 
 Back to top 

 Dependencies: 
 
 Accelerated Mobile Pages (AMP) branch 8.x-1.x 
 Video Embed Field branch 8.x-1.x 
 Back to top
